fact: Presenting bill 002-25 amending the Civil Status Code to the National Assembly, which adopted it on Monday 27 January 2025, the Minister of the Interior said applying Law 2011-003 had shown gaps in registration, amendment of register data and adaptation to digitalisation, and that amended article 15 introduces remote services letting the agency deliver documents outside the centres and establishes the electronic signature for civil status acts.
title: L’Assemblée nationale adopte deux projets de loi sur les partis politiques et le code de l’état civil
